title: Decision: mimid-server store uses one writer connection
description: Problem (.7.28): concurrent store writers fail with SQLITE_BUSY after sqlx's default 5s busy_timeout under load (reproduced: about 5 in 1200 runs at 40-way load; BEGIN IMMEDIATE in claim_key_packages). Options: raise busy_timeout (rarer, not gone; SQLite retries are unfair), a 1-connection write pool, a mutex around writes (each method must remember it). Chosen (Mark, 2026-10-18): Store holds a separate 1-connection pool for ALL writes and keeps the existing pool for reads. In-process writers queue FIFO in sqlx, so SQLITE_BUSY between them cannot occur. Keep a busy_timeout for other processes (the admin CLI). It matches the hub's single-writer model (H7). ponytail: write throughput is capped at one transaction at a time; upgrade path would be per-table databases.
